planets.name: HD 73344 d
planets.description: Planet of HD 73344 found by radial velocity, with a 5820-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: HD 73344 d was found in 2025 by radial velocity; it does not cross its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around HD 73344. Its orbit, tilt included, follows Zhang et al. 2025's fit, and its size is the archive's model from its mass.
